title: DevSteward REQ frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a requirement file. The Markdown body (Context, Decisions, Requirement, Notes prose + the `yaml acceptance` block) is validated structurally by the linter, not here.

id.description: Zero-padded requirement id, e.g. REQ-001. An optional single lowercase letter splits an umbrella REQ into sub-parts (e.g. REQ-028p), purely lexically — no parent/child semantics.

verified_by.description: Free text: how this REQ was verified (e.g. a commit sha or test run).

process.description: Optional intake-time process declarations (REQ-027). Absent keys default to develop: fused, concept: false, lab: [].

develop.description: fused = one design+build session (default); split = an attended design review before build, for genuinely risky REQs.

concept.description: Whether a concept phase (risk buy-down / spike where final test specs and lab needs are frozen) precedes develop.

lab.description: REQs owning the lab assets the System-Test phase requires; references are lint-resolved like depends_on.
